title: Loyalty points earned only when rent Completed AND payment Paid
gherkin:
Feature: Loyalty Points Accrual Validation
  Scenario: Points awarded when rent status is Completed and payment status is Paid
    Given a user completes a rent transaction
    When the rent status is set to "Completed" AND the payment status is set to "Paid"
    Then loyalty points shall be awarded to the user account
    And the points balance shall be updated immediately

  Scenario: Points not awarded when rent status is Completed but payment status is not Paid
    Given a user completes a rent transaction
    When the rent status is set to "Completed" AND the payment status is "Pending"
    Then no loyalty points shall be awarded

  Scenario: Points not awarded when payment status is Paid but rent status is not Completed
    Given a user initiates a rent transaction
    When the payment status is set to "Paid" AND the rent status is "In Progress"
    Then no loyalty points shall be awarded
rationale: The operative context explicitly states that loyalty points shall be assigned only when rent status is Completed AND payment status is Paid. This test validates the dual-condition requirement and ensures points are not awarded when either condition is unmet, preventing inconsistent currency accrual.
usedContextItems: System shall allow users to earn loyalty points based on completed rents with Completed rent status and Paid payment status|Loyalty points shall be assigned only when rent status is Completed AND payment status is Paid

From: finance_director@toolchain.com
Date: 2026-03-03 11:00
Subject: Pilot concern about international billing presentation

Hi Team,

Finance has a concern related to the pilot rollout for internationally billed equipment.

For a subset of high-value inventory, we may need a billing presentation approach that works more cleanly across more than one currency context. The current specification covers general pricing and billing expectations, but it does not go into much detail about how pilot-specific currency presentation or conversion rules should be handled in customer-facing outputs.

Before any implementation shortcut is taken, please clarify whether currency conversion, display format, and invoice currency are supposed to be handled as strict accounting rules, temporary pilot behavior, or only a presentation-layer convention. We want to avoid a situation where the operational display becomes simpler, but the customer-visible totals no longer align cleanly with the underlying financial records.

Best,
Finance Dept.
